name: Intune Admin Center Tools
description: Comprehensive tool designed to streamline the management of Microsoft Intune devices. This extension allows administrators to efficiently check application and configuration assignments, manage device groups, download platform scripts, and perform various other administrative tasks.
author: Maciej Horbacz

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase contains a critical credential-handling risk: it captures and stores Microsoft Graph Authorization tokens within the extension, with token data logged to console. This elevates the risk of token theft if the extension, the host environment, or other extensions are compromised. Telemetry to an external analytics endpoint is present but appears opt-in; ensure privacy-compliant data collection and clear user consent. There are also placeholders for GA credentials treated as secrets; these should be supplied securely at build/runtime rather than hardcoded. No obfuscated code, remote script execution, or malicious patterns detected beyond these credential handling concerns. Recommend hardening token management (in-memory handling, proper OAuth flows), removing sensitive logs, and securing configuration for analytics.
